proofUses.reason: The reflected rational fields have a purely imaginary weighted sum. Collecting the one-point and pair logarithmic drifts gives a stochastic exponential. The normalized center-mark limit agrees with omitting that zero-force mark.

Analytic continuation and a normalized reflected-pair limit justify the boundary replacement. Bounded stopped stochastic-logarithm coefficients transfer the exponential identity to mixed configurations; the all-boundary powers are computed explicitly.
Novikov and Girsanov give the angular force drift on compact stops, with no force-weight balance condition. The reflected vector-field convention and the boundary cotangent equations are checked.

For N-1 force marks of weight two, substitution gives the general radial and derivative powers, and their kappa6 and kappa2 specializations. The source rare-event interpretations are described as proposed probability formulas, not proved discrete asymptotics.
